Who We Are

A Nairobi SEO agency built on craft and commercial focus.

RankForge Kenya is a modern SEO and organic-growth agency based in Nairobi. We help businesses improve search visibility, attract qualified organic traffic and turn their websites into stronger lead-generation channels.

Our work is practical and analytical — technical improvements, content planning, local SEO and measurable organic-growth work, rather than generic marketing packages.

We work with Kenyan SMEs, professional-service firms, ecommerce and hospitality businesses, B2B companies and regional East African brands that need stronger online acquisition.

Our Principles

How we approach every engagement.

Commercial relevance

We prioritise the searches and improvements connected to actual business opportunities — not vanity metrics.

Technical clarity

We solve the structural problems that make websites harder for search engines and users to understand.

bundle.notes: ONE repair, changed files only: index.html, site.css

truthFindings.detail: home: trust label 'S. Mwangi' is not backed by the Business Facts (home: trust context <section class="testimonial-band">)
home: trust label 'A. Otieno' is not backed by the Business Facts (home: trust context <section class="testimonial-band">)

findings.title: Candidate is a Cloudflare placeholder — no site rendered
findings.reference: Reference desktop and mobile show the complete multi-section marketing page: full-viewport photographic hero with dark rounded panel and violet pill CTA, pale-lilac about split, 9–10 icon-card services grid, why-us split with floating metric cards over a photo tile, FAQ accordion with violet collapsed bars beside an illustration, duotone photographic testimonial band, newsletter split, black CTA block with violet ribbon and floating contact strip, and a 4-column footer with social buttons.
findings.candidate: Candidate desktop and mobile both render only the Cloudflare empty-domain page: pale blue background, a pixel-cloud browser illustration, 'There is nothing here yet', 'If you expect something to be here, it may take some time. Please check back again later.' and a 'Powered by CLOUDFLARE' credit. No sections, imagery or components exist.
findings.direction: This is a deployment failure, not a design defect: publish the actual built site to the candidate origin (fix DNS/hosting, deploy the bundle to the correct route), confirm all four routed pages resolve with the intended HTML, then regenerate fresh desktop and mobile full-page captures for re-evaluation.

findings.title: No photographic hero or panel composition
findings.reference: Desktop hero is a full-viewport (~92vh) photo of a team at work under a violet duotone overlay, with a dark rounded content panel (brand pill, 3-line white H1, short white paragraphs, violet pill CTA 'Entre Em Contacto') on the left; mobile keeps the same photo hero with the panel stacked over it.
findings.candidate: Absent — the placeholder page has no hero at all; the only imagery is the Cloudflare pixel-cloud illustration on a pale blue field, the exact opposite of the required photo-backed dark-overlaid hero (anti-pattern: light hero background).
findings.direction: Implement the home hero per blueprint: full-bleed home-hero photo with #17102B 72% overlay, 92vh (70svh mobile), left panel #2A2150 ~85% radius 16px with brand chip, clamp(44px,6vw,84px) H1 ≤15ch, two short white paragraph lines, single violet pill CTA and pulsing 'Available for projects' badge.

findings.title: Violet/lilac token system entirely missing
findings.reference: Confident violet (#6D28D9) leads throughout: violet pill chips and buttons, pale lilac (#F6F4FD) alternating bands, lilac icon tiles, violet collapsed FAQ bars, violet duotone testimonial band, and a black footer block with violet diagonal ribbon and floating white contact strip card.
findings.candidate: The only colors are Cloudflare's pale blue (#EAF6FC-ish) circle, white, black text and orange accent dots — none of the blueprint tokens (ground-lilac, accent #6D28D9, accent-soft #EDE9FD, ground-deep #0D0D12, hairline #E4E0F2) appear anywhere.
findings.direction: Apply the token system exactly: white/lilac alternating section grounds, #6D28D9 solid pill CTAs and chips, #EDE9FD icon tiles, #1A1333/#565071 ink, black #0D0D12 footer with violet ribbon — no gradients on buttons, no template pastel styling.

findings.title: Signature components and section stack unrendered
findings.reference: Signature elements are all present in the reference: lilac icon-chip service cards with pill 'Ver Mais' buttons and a full-width split card; why-us split with two floating white metric cards over the photo tile; FAQ accordion with one white expanded card and five violet collapsed bars; duotone testimonial band with two overlapping white quote cards and translucent quote glyphs; newsletter 2-up name row plus full-width email and checkbox.
findings.candidate: None exist — there are no cards, icon tiles, accordions, metric cards, quote cards, forms or footer columns; the page consists of one illustration and two lines of placeholder text.
findings.direction: Build the full home section stack per blueprint: about split with rounded photo tile and dotted motif, 9–10 white radius-20px bordered icon cards with 'View details →' ghost pills, why-us 55/45 split with two floating metric cards, FAQ two-column with violet collapsed bars, duotone testimonial band, newsletter split form, and the black contact CTA with ribbon and floating white contact strip.

findings.title: Typography and responsive character default to OS fonts
findings.reference: Geometric sans (Poppins/Inter) throughout: 700–800 weight near-black #1A1333 headlines with tight 1.05–1.1 line-height, 12–13px 600 pill chips, 15–16px #565071 body; mobile render preserves type scale, stacked panels and condensed rhythm rather than shrinking to a broken page.
findings.candidate: Single default system sans: one 26px bold heading 'There is nothing here yet' and 14px gray body text; mobile capture is a centered narrow column with no typographic hierarchy, nav, chips or scale adaptation.
findings.direction: Load Poppins (display 700/800) + Inter (body), implement the token scale (H1 clamp(44px,6vw,84px) lh 1.05 ≤15ch; H2 clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px) lh 1.12; chips 12px 600; body 15px/1.6), and verify the <640px single-column adaptation (hamburger overlay nav, 1-col service grid, stacked testimonial cards, stacked contact strip).

visualQa.summary: The candidate cannot be evaluated as a design because it never rendered: both desktop and mobile captures show the Cloudflare 'There is nothing here yet' empty-domain placeholder instead of the built site. Consequently every scored dimension collapses — the violet/lilac palette, full-viewport photographic hero with dark rounded panel, 9–10 icon-card services grid, why-us metric split, violet-bar FAQ accordion, duotone testimonial band, newsletter form, black ribbon footer, Poppins/Inter typography and all responsive behavior are entirely absent, replaced by a pale-blue illustration and two lines of placeholder text. This is a hosting/deployment failure rather than a styling miss: the correct repair is to publish the actual bundle to the candidate origin, confirm all four routes serve real HTML, and resubmit fresh captures. No design judgment about fidelity is possible until a genuine render exists; scores are set near the floor to reflect total absence of the reference design language.
